duplicates.note: Context overlays repeat candidate ids on purpose; the index stores one row.

limitations: 113 Earth candidate windows and 18 Moon / 5 Mars reference windows only.
WorldCover context observations are context-only and never enter the similarity score.

overlaps.note: Reference windows have no WGS84 bbox claim; overlap is not evaluated.

limitations: 168 cells in three bounded pilot regions; the bbox envelope is not a coverage claim.
250 m-derived coarse metrics are not the fine 90 m terrain method.

overlaps.note: Candidate ids are unique and projected stride_m == window_size_m. Adjacent WGS84 bbox envelopes can overlap by a sub-cell margin because each cell envelope is rounded independently after projection.

limitations: Map units and spectral indices are evidence, not mineral abundance.
Unknown/mineral states are preserved; no quantitative mineral is fabricated.
